summary: The parent implementation classifies 0/1 as positive, making signum() return 1 instead of 0; zero with a negative denominator is incorrectly classified as negative. The fix checks strictly positive or negative numerator/denominator combinations, excluding zero from both predicates. The upstream test extended by this fix first detects the regression at assert_eq!(_0.signum(), Zero::zero()). Select test::test_signed in the num-rational crate at rational/Cargo.toml. No tests were executed.
